args.root_cause: The OPS-250 deploy of server.properties (deploy/2026-11-01-server-properties.md) was only supposed to raise max-players from 20 to 40. It also set white-list=true and enforce-whitelist=true while whitelist.json was empty ([]). After the deploy restart, every player (Steve_Mines, Alex_Builds, new players) was kicked with "You are not whitelisted on this server!".
args.actions: 1. Checked the baseline status and server.properties. 2. Saw the server go down for the deploy restart. Compared the new server.properties with deploy/previous/server.properties and read the deploy note: the whitelist changes were not intended. 3. Declared the incident. 4. While the server was still starting, rewrote server.properties with white-list=false and enforce-whitelist=false, keeping max-players=40. The server had already loaded the bad values, so this write did not take effect. 5. Tried to start the server; it was already running, so nothing happened. 6. Once it was up, confirmed whitelist rejections in the log, then ran the console command 'whitelist off'. 7.
